title: Virtual users
description: Manage service identities and virtual access tokens for applications, automation, and production workloads.

usersTable.emptyDescription: Create your first virtual user to give an application or service an independent identity.

tokensTable.name: Name
tokensTable.empty: No VATs issued for this virtual user.

detail.emptyDescription: Choose a service identity to manage its production gateway tokens.

createUser.title: Create virtual user
createUser.description: Create a virtual account (not connected to a real user) for applications, CI/CD, or production services.

editUser.title: Edit virtual user
editUser.description: Update identity scope or deactivate it to block all issued VATs.

deleteUser.title: Delete virtual user
deleteUser.description: Type "{alias}" to delete this virtual user.

createToken.title: Create Virtual Access Token (VAT)
createToken.description: Issue a gateway token for this service identity.
createToken.expiryExamples: Valid examples: 30m (thirty minutes), 24h (twenty-four hours), 7d (seven days), 30d (thirty days).
createToken.noModels: No VAT model scope is available for this team.
createToken.modelHint: This selection can only narrow the Provider Account and Deployment scope; it cannot grant new access. Leave all unchecked to inherit the virtual user's full model scope.

upgradeDialog.title: This feature is not available on your current plan
upgradeDialog.description: Creating virtual users and virtual access tokens is not included in your current commercial plan. Upgrade your plan to use this feature.

confirm.rotateDescription: Rotate "{name}"? The current token is revoked immediately and a new secret is shown once.
confirm.revokeDescription: Revoke access key "{name}"? Existing applications using it will stop authenticating.

oneTime.title: Copy VAT now
oneTime.description: This raw token is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
oneTime.copyHint: Store the token in your application secret manager before closing.
oneTime.copyFailed: Failed to copy token. Please copy it manually.

messages.deleteUserActiveTokenWarning: {count} non-revoked VATs are still associated with this virtual user. Revoke them before deletion if running clients still use them.
messages.deleteConfirmAlias: Type the virtual user's technical ID to confirm deletion.
messages.aliasPattern: Technical ID must start with a letter or number and use only letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
messages.teamRequired: Assign this virtual user to a team before issuing a VAT.
